meta.description: Hand-maintained manifest. id, family, axes, C/A coverage, API refs, verification per variant. Schema supports 23 families x 5 = 115 records; this file holds only the ACTIVE families built so far (merge-only — never delete/overwrite a sibling family's records).
meta.tokens: shared/tokens.css (single locked blue scheme) + shared/base.css (reset/primitives only)
meta.authorship: All 85 variants hand-authored; no design-generation script used. F19–F22 records were appended as a pure text merge — all 65 earlier sibling records are byte-for-byte unchanged. See DECISIONS.md.

verification_method.static: node --check on all 50 F14–F18 inline scripts (0 errors) · script-stripped href/src target existence (0 broken) · duplicate-id scan (0) · remote-asset scan (0) · dead-link scan (0 real href="#") · JSON parse of manifest (65 records)
verification_method.runtime_f14_f18: Playwright Chromium 156 headless: 25 variants × 2 themes × 5 widths (360/390/768/1024/1440) = 250 page loads with 0 console/page errors, 0 failed requests and 0 page-level horizontal overflow; command palette, state pills, focus trap, Esc, theme toggle, tabs, no-JS fallback and reduced motion all pass; computed-colour AA sweep in both themes (0 text below 4.5:1 / 3:1 large); computed font-size sweep (0 text below 11px)
verification_method.final_button_smoke: 2026-10-28 post-merge pass: every non-state button in all 25 F14–F18 pages clicked in Chromium (native prompt/confirm stubbed) = 418 clicks, 0 JS errors, 0 leaked body-scroll locks. Found and fixed F14 V1's missing dialog scroll lock and F16 V1's unhandled clipboard writeText rejection. Full static suite rerun after the F14 ledger-note, gallery, DECISIONS and Gate T doc edits: 0 broken links, 0 remote assets, 0 duplicate IDs, 0 JS syntax errors.
verification_method.gallery_qa: index.html was loaded at 360/768/1440 in light + dark: 65 cards, 13 family sections, 14 select options, 0 errors, 0 horizontal overflow; F18 filter narrows to 5 variants; all five new footer DELIVERY-REPORT.md links resolve.
verification_method.runtime_earlier_families: jsdom headless execution of the F05–F13 pages: theme, state switcher, tabs, chips, command palette, help, detail drawers, search/filter, form validation+submit, stepper, budget guide, dropzone, cancel dialogs — 0 runtime errors
verification_method.screenshot_note: Chromium was used for computed-style / layout / interaction assertions. Pixel screenshots were not archived; light/dark parity is asserted from computed colours and contrast ratios rather than from saved images. 'Hierarchy understood in <2s' was not human-timed; only its structural preconditions were verified. Stated explicitly per Gate 3.
verification_method.limitations: No live backend: all api_refs are documentation of verified spec paths, never calls. F14 KPI totals do not reconcile to the 11-row ledger gross and are labelled as separate captures. F18 dates / overdue text and F17 '12 days overdue' are derived, not captured fields. No statement/GST, AI, UPI-mandate, card-verification, promo, guest-checkout or currency endpoint exists; those CTAs are demo-labelled. F15 V2–V5 use native prompt() for rename; F14 V3 combines a shared dialog with a custom drawer; F18 V3 chips are not sticky. Gate T R1–R12 were fetched in full, four later searches were snippet-only. See DECISIONS.md §9.6 and each family's docs/DELIVERY-REPORT.md.

meta.generated_note: records[].verification.widths lists CSS breakpoints implemented; for F14–F18 those widths were also measured in Chromium
meta.last_merge: F19–F22: 20 records appended 2026-10-28 (total 85 across 17 families); no earlier record was modified
